company.name: BackerKit
company.shortDescription: BackerKit manages your post-crowdfunding mayhem so that you can deliver on time.
company.description:
BackerKit simplifies the post-campaign fulfillment process by helping project creators handle all the realities of crowdfunding. It allows its clients to survey, collect data, accept pre-orders, and process pledges for fulfillment.

BackerKit was founded in 2012 by Rosanna Yau and Maxwell Salzberg and is based in San Francisco, California.
